items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Heard the name, I never knew.

ctx.x: Heard the name, I never knew. He was a real light fellow. And Little Mac, we would call him. Yes. And Black Benny. Those were drums.
But did Black Benny travel with you? I didn't know he ever went anyplace except for him.
